text:
Maya Patel: quick follow-up from the cache-thrash postmortem — we need explicit owners, JIRA links, and QA acceptance criteria before we close the RCA. @Ravi @Lei can you claim primary owners?

Ravi Singh: I'll pick up the fix (race in eviction). assigning myself to https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-4567 — will aim for a PR by EOD Friday.

Sam K: can we also add a small canary + regression test? I can own the test harness if someone creates the ticket.

Lei Chen: happy to own QA acceptance and canary roll plan. will write acceptance steps and failure modes. cc: @Maya for sign-off.

oncall-bot: Incident #2026-03-14-Cache-Thrash — postmortem published (link: https://redwood.intranet/pm/2026-03-14-cache-thrash).

Maya Patel: thanks — let's capture RACI here and concrete due dates so we can track. propose: Ravi = R (owner), Maya = A (approver), Lei = C (QA), Sam = C/I (tests + monitoring). thoughts?

Ravi Singh: sounds good. timeline: patch + unit tests by Fri (2026-03-20), integration + canary next Wed (2026-03-25).

Sam K: ok, I'll add the synthetic load job and canary config once JIRA-4568 exists. can we make 72h soak mandatory before promote? :thumbsup:

Lei Chen: yes 72h soak. I'll also add acceptance checklist and breakage signals. quick checklist in PR comments should include exact metrics and thresholds.

Maya Patel: adding the concrete action list here; everyone confirm and I'll create the tracking epic.

```
Action items:
- JIRA-4567: Fix cache eviction race — owner: Ravi Singh — due: 2026-03-20 — R: Ravi, A: Maya, C: Lei, I: Sam
- JIRA-4568: Canary + regression test + soak — owner: Sam K — due: 2026-03-25 — R: Sam, A: Maya, C: Lei, I: Ravi
- JIRA-4569: QA acceptance criteria + runbook updates — owner: Lei Chen — due: 2026-03-22 — R: Lei, A: Maya, C: Ravi, I: SRE
```

Ravi Singh: confirmed JIRA-4567 created and linked in PR. I put a TODO in the issue for kernel of fix and perf check.

Sam K: created JIRA-4568 and added the canary config template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-4568

Lei Chen: JIRA-4569 created with the checklist, I'll DM Maya for final sign-off tomorrow.

Maya Patel: great — I'll open an epic to track these and schedule a short handoff on Mon to confirm owners and risks. if anyone needs to swap ownership, ping me before EOD. :white_check_mark:

Sam K: noted. also let's mark this a recurring incident pattern in the RCA so platform team can prioritize broader mitigation.

Maya Patel: agreed — add a label "recurring-pattern" on the epic and I'll bring to infra planning.

oncall-bot: Reminder: follow-up review scheduled in 1 week (2026-03-27).

Ravi Singh: ack, will have update by then.

Lei Chen: ack.

Maya Patel: thanks team — closing the loop here.
